method: Exact exhaustive enumeration; no Monte Carlo.
reference: optimal-manual: maximize expected payout over all legal manual placements BEFORE the final three unknown balls; automatic policy prioritizes completions then long reaches without EV maximization.

initialFreePolicy.selection: Select a calibrated pool, then select a layout uniformly within that pool, then shuffle the 25 distinct numbers. No reroll or adjustment after the round starts.
initialFreePolicy.symmetry: Asymmetric layouts and their distinct reflections are separate equally likely variants; mirror equivalence reduces calibration work but does not impose board symmetry.

uniformPositionFeasibility.conclusion: Uniform placement of 1, 2 or 3 initial FREE cells cannot achieve 50% with the unchanged payouts; position weights are required.
monotonicityProof: Fix a first-five hit set H and compare initial sets I and I union {x}. If x is in H, the new layout receives one extra manual FREE, so the old strategy can be retained and supplemented.
If x is not in H and not manually chosen by the old strategy, retain the old manual choices; one additional cell is marked and odds are unchanged.

If x was manually chosen, replace its manual FREE with another eligible cell y. Couple each equally likely final triple D to the triple obtained by swapping x and y. The manual-hit multiplier is identical under this bijection, while the new marked set contains the old marked set.

Every payout tier is nondecreasing with completed lines, so the new conditional expected payout is at least the old one. Maximizing preserves this inequality. Nested uniformly sampled initial sets therefore give optimal mean returns for counts 2 and 3 at least the exact count-1 mean.

enumeration.oddsRule: 1 + raw hits on player FREE in last three only; initial FREE hits grant extra player FREE during first five only; no line awards
enumeration.payoutTiers: counts above last defined tier receive that last tier, not a new payout

precision.note: The raw integer sums are exhaustive, not estimates. Pool means and mixtures use IEEE-754 doubles; all 101 integer targets are checked to absolute error < 1e-10 percentage points. Symmetric layouts are exact weighted mirror representatives; asymmetric layouts enumerate all 53130 first-five sets.
